# Model Recommendations

Provides AI model recommendations based on task requirements and constraints.

## Usage
- Analyzes task type, data size, and latency requirements
- Recommends top models from HuggingFace, ONNX Zoo, and local registry
- Compares models by accuracy, speed, size, and license compatibility
- Provides one-click setup commands for the recommended model
